verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an inference API, but the evidence documents no batch endpoint or multi-item operation. The Flex service tier is aimed at 'asynchronous workloads' and 'data enrichment', but it only changes the cost and priority of individual Chat Completions requests, so it is an adjacent feature rather than bulk processing. The OpenAPI spec is cited only as existing, with no batch paths named.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
